bloques.titulo: The proportional correlation je hdesto / umso
texto: The **je … desto** (or **je … umso**) correlative connective pair is used to link two different dimensions that vary in an interdependent way. Each member must introduce a comparative adjective: the **je** clause acts as a subordinate with the finite verb at the end (**Je gründlicher die Vorbereitung ist, …**), while the **desto / umso** clause acts as the main with the second metric verb (**… desto schneller erzielt man Resultate**).
